summary: Implemented prepareUpdate and the Update container as specified, by reading and editing only; no tests were run and nothing was committed. Changes: Update(prologue, algebra) class in rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py; translateUpdate in algebra.py now returns Update(prologue, res), with the translated prologue; evalUpdate in update.py iterates update.algebra and has an updated docstring; prepareUpdate added in processor.py beside prepareQuery, recording _original_args; prepareUpdate exported from rdflib/plugins/sparql/__init__.py; new test module test/test_sparql_prepared_update.py. Deviation: the empty-request early return now returns Update(translatePrologue([], base, initNs), []) instead of a bare list, because the spec requires empty evaluation not to raise and processUpdate("") must keep working. Unverified: the INSERT ... WHERE {} initBindings test assumes one solution carries the binding; the DAWG tests were not run.
